firstPlayerRule: The player who most recently smelled a flower starts.
clarifications: In three- or four-player games, that player makes the first two-card offer to the player on their left. Offers continue clockwise until everyone has four cards.
internalEvidence: Rendered and rotated the booklet imposition on PDF page 1. Its Setup panel gives the flower-smelling criterion, and its Offers panel defines the first action. The sheet credits Button Shy Games and Elizabeth Hargrave; 18 Flower cards match inventory BGG 257614. SHA-256: cfda261e0af72088f150056890cf5914f52f996e00d44c9d198a183d60a76cbd. Owner authorized assistant review on 2026-09-22. Editorial review 2026-09-24: Rechecked the opening instruction, game identity and named edition against the rendered rulebook.
uncertainty: The rules specify no tie procedure for a shared flower smell.
